summary: Mixedbread's Starter plan is free and includes $5 in one-time credits — no card required — with 3 workspace users, 3 stores, 100 queries/minute, and 6,000 upload requests/minute across its knowledge stack (Toast 1 agent, indexing, semantic/grep search, storage). Every plan bills at the same usage rates. When Starter credits run out, the current FAQ directs users to upgrade to Scale. Separately, Mixedbread for startups offers $250 in one-time credits to qualified startups; eligibility is listed on its pricing page.
claim_steps: Sign up for the free Starter plan at https://www.mixedbread.com/pricing — no card required.
$5 in one-time credits is included, with 3 workspace users, 3 stores, 100 queries/minute, and 6,000 upload requests/minute.
When credits run out, the pricing FAQ directs you to upgrade to Scale ($20/mo, included as monthly credits); this is not a replenishing free allowance.
